label: UFC / MMA

data.source: ESPN public scoreboard, month by month (model_loop/adapters/ufc/ingest.py)

temporal.known_at: each bout priced from ratings before its date

method: walk-forward Elo, symmetric in the feed's order, tuned on 2016-2020 under a preregistered protocol (docs/model-loop/ufc/prereg.json)

confirmation.calibration_slope_method: slope-only recalibration p' = sigmoid(b logit p): a symmetric model has no side to fit an intercept for

holdout_2025.calibration_slope_method: slope-only recalibration p' = sigmoid(b logit p): a symmetric model has no side to fit an intercept for

live_served.calibration_slope_method: slope-only recalibration p' = sigmoid(b logit p): a symmetric model has no side to fit an intercept for
live_served.note: the served version's changes after 1.0.0 were chosen on the full window by the weekly rule; this season is their clean test

moneyline.market_reason: no archive of timestamped UFC closing prices is on file

unresolved: Round-level fight statistics (UFCStats refuses automated access; an authorised feed is needed) for the method and round markets.
A closing-price archive: until one exists nothing here can be called an edge.
